   1 # Scene Descriptions: Velvet Eclipse / 绯月赌城
   2 
   3 **Tag:** v0.1.0
   4 
   5 PLAN.md supplies every task, mechanic, scene path and resource mapping; STRUCTURE.md supplies the room schema and ECS ownership. All scene/resource paths below are planned end-of-tag contracts unless already present, not a readiness claim. Resolution reference for every scene: 1280×720, with a 32 px outer UI safe margin. Native and actual Web output must preserve readable framing.
   6 
   7 The five rooms are JSON compositions inside `scenes/game_world.tscn`, not new gameplay controller scenes. Coordinates in Elements describe viewport composition, not physics guarantees. Choose room dimensions and final ledge coordinates using measured movement envelopes: the unchanged Lobby upper gap must exceed every permitted pre-relic jump/dodge trajectory but remain reachable with a normal second jump. Bind visible art independently of collision.
   8 
   9 Source-only anchors use the exact existing paths below/under individual scenes. They are never runtime textures or completed screen-reference results; no additional screen-reference generation is needed. Screenshot criteria describe visible states; mechanics, timing, reachability, pause and persistence still require PLAN execution evidence.
